correction: A same-origin Web Vitals POST aborted with ERR_ABORTED after observed 204 is recorded as accepted telemetry with an aborted browser transport. A response-less telemetry abort is exempt only with an observed pagehide/navigation-start within 1000 ms; acceptance and execution region remain unknown. HTTP errors and any observed incorrect/missing function execution region always fail. Application failures and displayed-state/readiness gates are unchanged. Setup/warmup/cleanup cancellations are retained separately from measured action failures, as setup was excluded from October action timings.
